invariants.rationale: The method uses map unconditionally, so it must not be null.
parentLayers is used in parentLayers.add(layer), so it must not be null.
element is dereferenced in element.getName(), so it must not be null.
tmxFile is passed to getRelativeFileHandle and used to resolve image files; it must not be null.
imageResolver is used in imageResolver.getImage, so it must not be null.
